Class Parent

java.lang.Object
petgame.Parent
public class Parent extends Object
This class represents a player who interacts with the pet. The player handles actions such as feeding, playing, exercising, sleeping, giving gifts, and visiting the vet.
Author:
Liam Wray 251230783
